text.en:
Lifting of the Mandated Price Ceilings on Rice. Following the
recommendation of the DA and DTI, the mandated price ceilings on regular milled and
well-milled rice under EO No. 39 are hereby lifted.

Directive to Other Agencies. To ensure stability of rice prices upon
the lifting of the mandated price ceilings, other concerned agencies, consistent with
their respective mandates, shall fortify their existing programs and initiatives to provide
support and assistance to farmers, retailers, and consumers.

Separability. If any part or provision of this Order shall be held
invalid or unconstitutional, the provisions not affected thereby shall remain in full force

Repeal. EO No. 39 is hereby repealed. All other orders, rules and
regulations, and issuances or parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions
of this Order are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 4th day of
of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twenty-Three.
October , in the year
By the President:
